import subprocess, pathlib
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
cases=[
 [], ['-1'], ['-1','--color=never','--icons=never'], ['-a','-1'], ['-aa','-1'], ['-A','-1'],
 ['-l','--color=never','--icons=never'], ['-lh','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['-T','--color=never','--icons=never'], ['-T','-l','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['-1','--sort=name'], ['-1','--sort=Name'], ['-1','--sort=extension'], ['-1','--sort=size'], ['-1','--sort=modified'], ['-1','--sort=none'],
 ['-1','--group-directories-first'], ['-1','-r'], ['-d','-1'], ['-D','-1'], ['-f','-1'],
 ['-1','alpha.txt'], ['-1','missing'], ['-1','alpha.txt','missing'], ['-1','dirA','dirB'], ['-R','-1'], ['-R','-l','--color=never','--icons=never'],
]
for args in cases:
 p=subprocess.run([ref,*args,'probe-fixture'] if not any(x in args for x in ['alpha.txt','missing','dirA','dirB']) else [ref,*args],capture_output=True)
 print('\\nCASE',args,'RC',p.returncode)
 print('OUT',repr(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')))
 print('ERR',repr(p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')))
'@ | python -"
